label: INTERNAL REVIEW
travelingCohort: Chemistry researchers, scientific presenters and exhibitors participating in ACS's national meeting. Nonlocal attendance and overnight needs are reasonable inferences from the national scientific event, not verified room commitments.
demandSignal: The American Chemical Society has a dated national meeting at SDCC and a published event-team contact, supporting a future-cycle scientific lodging account prospect.
whyWyndhamFits: The confirmed SDCC venue places the activity approximately 1 mile from Wyndham San Diego Bayside. Its downtown bayfront setting could suit a delegate, staff or scientific-program sub-block; no attempt is made to equate the full national meeting with the hotel's room inventory.

contact.name: Kim Wang
contact.role: Manager, Meeting Operations, per professional profile; official directory lists Sr. Lead, Meeting Operations.

sourcingStatus: ACS confirms the future meeting. The reviewed future-meeting and exhibitor pages do not establish a 2027 hotel roster, an accommodation RFP or remaining uncommitted room blocks.
recommendedFirstAction: Reach Kim Wang (k_wang@acs.org) regarding American Chemical Society lodging/meeting needs for Wyndham San Diego Bayside.
specificQuestion: Are you still evaluating downtown / bayfront lodging or meeting space for this cohort, and what peak room nights / dates should we check?
